6. La connaissance et la libération
424.
Objection :
Astu vā viṣayāntarasañcārākhyapratibandhanivṛttirūpatayā jñānahetutvaṃ saṃprajñātayogasya,
kṣīṇavṛtter abhijātasyeva maṇer grahītṛgrahaṇagrāhyeṣu tatsthatañjanatāsamāpattir ity
āgamisūtrāc ca ; na tu asaṃprajñātayogasyāpi tasya jñānajanyatvāt, na ca jñānotpattyanantaraṃ
mokṣāya anyat sādhanam apekṣaṇīyaṃ tasya tāvad eva ciraṃ yāvan na vimokṣye'tha saṃpatsya
